text:
flagreaper: harvests flags whose rollout ended; clear at a glance
deadflag: names exactly what it finds; easy to grep and remember
fossil: flags preserved in code long after they stopped living
tombstone: marks dead flags for removal
stale: plain, honest, fits a CLI (`stale scan`)

pick: flagreaper. Self-explanatory to new hires, memorable without being cute
availability against existing internal tool names: unchecked
